content.text: Default MongoDB installations have no authentication. In production, always enable authentication, TLS, and restrict network access.

content.code:
security:
  authorization: enabled
net:
  tls:
    mode: requireTLS
    certificateKeyFile: /etc/ssl/mongodb.pem

content.text: Never expose MongoDB port 27017 directly to the internet. Use a firewall and VPN.

questions.question: What MongoDB config option enables authentication?
questions.explanation: Set security.authorization: enabled in mongod.conf to require authentication.

faq.q: How do I encrypt data at rest?
faq.a: MongoDB Enterprise and Atlas provide Encrypted Storage Engine. For Community Edition, use Linux full-disk encryption (LUKS).
